name: Ben View House

tagline.en: A guesthouse full of character on Bridge Street, in the heart of Clifden, run by the same family since 1926.
tagline.ga: Teach aíochta lán de charachtar ar Shráid an Droichid, i gcroílár an Chlocháin, á reáchtáil ag an teaghlach céanna ó 1926.

mapQuery: Ben View House, Bridge Street, Clifden, Co. Galway

en: Ben View House has welcomed guests to Clifden for nearly a century. The same family has run it since 1926, and it still has all the character you’d hope for.
We’re on Bridge Street, so the shops, restaurants and music pubs of Clifden are on the doorstep, with the Sky Road, Connemara National Park and Kylemore Abbey a short drive away.
Ben View has been recommended by the Frommer’s and Le Petit Futé guides.
ga: Tá Ben View House ag cur fáilte roimh aíonna go dtí an Clochán le beagnach céad bliain. Tá sé á reáchtáil ag an teaghlach céanna ó 1926, agus tá an carachtar ar fad ann fós a mbeifeá ag súil leis.

Táimid ar Shráid an Droichid, mar sin tá siopaí, bialanna agus tithe tábhairne ceoil an Chlocháin ag an doras, agus Bóthar na Spéire, Páirc Náisiúnta Chonamara agus Mainistir na Coille Móire gearrthuras uait.
Mhol treoirleabhair Frommer’s agus Le Petit Futé Ben View.
